description: qou-pdix branch 3. Entry 5 defines the one contentful branch as a connection 'whose monodromy reproduces the Hecke braiding', escaping the rationality exclusion 'because a holonomy is transcendental'. That escape fails for the monodromy reading: Kohno-Drinfeld gives holonomies GAUGE-CONJUGATE to the braid-image matrices, conjugation PRESERVES THE TRACE, and the carrier condition is on the trace. Verified symbolically: every generator has det = -1 exactly so an even-length word has det = +1 and the carrier's `M.det = 1` field is AUTOMATIC and free (it was never the obstruction); every word trace is a Laurent polynomial in Z[q,q^-1], the seminormal radical cancelling identically; and (sigma_0 sigma_1)^3 = I exactly, so the rep factors through B_3/centre = PSL(2,Z) and the achievable traces are a countable set of Laurent polynomials. 2*cos((z-1)h/2) is transcendental over Q(q,z) by entry 4, so the trace field is impossible. Branch 3 AS WORDED is closed, with no associator and no zeta(3) computation — superseding the zeta(3) proposal noted earlier today. SURVIVES: the open-path / non-abelian Stokes reading, which is not a monodromy, not trace-pinned, and gauge-dependent rather than conjugation-covariant.

assertions.name: generators_have_det_minus_one_so_the_det_field_is_free
assertions.detail: in the (2,1) block det rho(sigma_0) = det rho(sigma_1) = det rho(sigma_0^-1) = det rho(sigma_1^-1) = -1 exactly, for every q, so an EVEN-length braid word has det = +1 exactly. The carrier's second field `M.det = 1` is automatic and free on the braid image — it was never the obstruction. (Quadratic and braid relations verified, so this really is the Hecke (2,1) rep.)

assertions.name: word_traces_are_laurent_polynomials_the_radical_cancels
assertions.detail: the seminormal off-diagonal carries sqrt(q^4+q^2+1), so a trace could have been irrational over Q(q). On ten even-length words it cancels identically and every trace lies in Z[q,q^-1], as characters must. So the carrier's FIRST field asks a Laurent polynomial to equal 2*cos(alpha), which entry 4 proves transcendental over Q(q,z)

assertions.name: full_twist_is_the_identity_so_the_rep_factors_through_PSL2Z
assertions.detail: (sigma_0 sigma_1)^3 = I exactly in the (2,1) block for every q — verified as a matrix identity, not merely a trace. The full twist generates the centre of B_3, so the representation factors through B_3/<Delta^2> = PSL(2,Z) and the achievable traces are indexed by conjugacy classes there: a countable set of Laurent polynomials

assertions.name: the_monodromy_reading_of_branch_3_is_closed_by_trace_invariance
assertions.detail: Kohno-Drinfeld gives holonomies gauge-conjugate to the braid-image matrices for any connection whose monodromy reproduces the Hecke braiding; conjugation PRESERVES THE TRACE and the carrier condition is ON the trace, so such a monodromy's trace is some tr rho(w) in Z[q,q^-1] and cannot be 2*cos(alpha). Branch 3 AS ENTRY 5 WORDS IT is closed, with no Drinfeld associator and no zeta(3) computation. Entry 5's escape clause 'a holonomy is transcendental' is the wrong reason: transcendental entries do not buy a transcendental closed-loop trace when the loop must reproduce the braiding. SURVIVES: the open-path / non-abelian Stokes reading, which is not a monodromy, not trace-pinned, and gauge-dependent rather than conjugation-covariant

context.axis: qou-pdix branch 3: does a KZ/Stokes connection escape the rationality exclusion?
context.answer: Not in the MONODROMY reading. Conjugation preserves the trace, so a monodromy reproducing the Hecke braiding has a Hecke trace — a Laurent polynomial — and cannot equal the transcendental 2*cos(alpha). Only the open-path / non-abelian Stokes reading survives.
context.supersedes: the zeta(3) t^3 test proposed earlier today, which targeted the monodromy reading now closed by a cheaper argument.
